detail.longDescription: Well, this is interesting! Sighted people in my life, some of them, are using software made for us such as # Paperback and stuff like # Fedra because they say they never have that visual bloat most software has today, and they like the speed of software like Paperback. Turns out sighted people *do* get tired looking at things. https:// github.com/trypsynth/paperback # Books # Bookstodon # OpenSource
